name: Sarah Mitchell
quote: I was diagnosed with a brain tumor and scheduled for surgery in just 48 hours. Back home, I would have waited 8 months. The neurosurgery team at Tiantan was world-class — and the care was surprisingly warm and personal.

name: James Crawford
quote: My bilateral knee replacement at Jishuitan cost less than a quarter of what I was quoted in the US. The surgeon was excellent, the physical therapy started the next day, and I was walking unassisted within 3 weeks.

name: Yuki Tanaka
quote: After three failed IVF cycles in Tokyo, I came to Peking Union. Their reproductive center was recommended by a friend. The doctors were thorough and kind, and I'm now expecting twins — at 42 years old.

name: Emma Thompson
quote: I'd lived with chronic back pain for 5 years. A combination of TCM acupuncture, herbal medicine, and targeted physical therapy at Guang'anmen Hospital gave me more relief than anything I'd tried back home. I finally sleep through the night.
